text: I'm fostering an 8 year old girl and I don't know if I'm overreacting. Her temp is 40. About twenty minutes ago she had what I think was a fit: she went stiff, then shook all over and her eyes rolled up. As far as I know this has never happened to her before. Since then she keeps covering her eyes and says the light hurts, so I've turned the big light off. I checked her for a rash and did the glass test on a couple of little marks on her arm and they went pale, so I think that's ok. Her neck seems fine, she can bend her head down to look at her tummy. Sorry if this is silly, I just wasn't sure who else to ask.
